description: Ambulance Services is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by Esri U.S. Federal Datasets. Medical Emergency Response Structures This feature layer, utilizing National Geospatial Data Asset (NGDA) data from the U.S. Geological Survey, displays hospitals, medical centers, ambulance services, fire stations and EMS stations in the U.S. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Esri U.S. Federal Datasets. Its keywords are NGDA, National Geospatial Data Asset, FGDC, Federal Geospatial Data Committee, structures, federal, USGS, U.S. Geological Survey. The bounding box given is -174.2030,18.0116,-65.7039,71.2879. The hub shows 2026-09-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fema-resilience-hub.
